items.exampleEn: The hunter knows every path in these mountains.
items.exampleZh: 那位獵人熟悉這片山裡的每一條小路。

items.exampleEn: Retired people often have a lot of free time.
items.exampleZh: 退休的人通常有很多空閒時間。

items.exampleEn: My uncle is a golf pro.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔是職業高爾夫球選手。

items.exampleEn: The fisherman sells fresh fish at the market every morning.
items.exampleZh: 那位漁夫每天早上在市場賣新鮮的魚。

items.exampleEn: She writes in her diary every night.
My barber is very kind and talks a lot.
items.exampleZh: 我的理髮師很親切，話也很多。

items.exampleEn: Many new parents have sleepless nights.
items.exampleZh: 很多新手爸媽常常整夜睡不好。

items.exampleEn: The businesswoman has meetings all day.
items.exampleZh: 那位女企業家整天都在開會。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather is retired, but he still works in his garden.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺退休了，但他還是在花園裡忙。

items.audioEn: The barber cut my hair too short this time.
items.audioZh: 這次理髮師把我的頭髮剪得太短了。
items.questionZh: 說話的人覺得頭髮怎麼了？

items.sentenceEn: After a sleepless night, I felt very tired.
items.sentenceZh: 一整夜沒睡之後，我覺得非常累。

items.sentenceEn: The hunter and his dog walked quietly through the forest.
items.sentenceZh: 獵人和他的狗靜悄悄地穿過森林。

items.stemEn: Yesterday I read my old ____ from when I was ten.
items.stemZh: 昨天我讀了我十歲時寫的舊日記。

items.stemEn: He's not a beginner. He plays like a ____.
items.stemZh: 他可不是新手，他打得像職業選手一樣。

items.passageEn: Lucy's grandfather is a retired fisherman. He kept a diary for fifty years about the sea and the weather. Lucy's mother is a busy businesswoman, and she often has sleepless nights because of work. Last week, Lucy read Grandpa's diary to her mother. It helped her relax, and she slept well that night.
items.passageZh: Lucy 的爺爺是一位退休的漁夫。他寫了五十年的日記，記錄大海和天氣。Lucy 的媽媽是個忙碌的女企業家，常常因為工作而失眠。上週，Lucy 把爺爺的日記唸給媽媽聽。這讓媽媽放鬆下來，那天晚上她睡得很好。

questions.questionZh: 爺爺五十年的日記記錄了什麼？
Lucy 的媽媽為什麼常常失眠？

items.promptZh: 這位理髮師剪頭髮剪得很好。
referenceEn: This barber cuts hair very well.
This barber is very good at cutting hair.
rubricZh: 主詞第三人稱單數時動詞加 s（例如 cuts）；寫 is good at cutting hair 也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 retired 造一個句子，說說一位已經退休的家人或朋友。
referenceEn: My retired father likes to cook for us.
My grandmother is retired and lives by the sea.
rubricZh: retired 是形容詞（例如 is retired、my retired father）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My grandmother is）
